note: Two sites off Cove Road south of Wells Tannery, about 450 m apart. Waterflat is a pad in the gravel parking lot of the Waterflat Trail ATV trailhead, with a vault toilet in the lot; in the summer ATV season (the Friday before Memorial Day to the last full weekend of September) the lot is used for unloading and riding, so expect trailers and machine noise. Cove Road Landing B is a secluded grass landing about 30 m by 20 m at the end of a narrow 0.15-mile track past a gate, dropping about 12 m from Cove Road. The booking page lists 10 ft of overhead clearance there; the landing itself is open to the sky but the track runs under trees, so a motorhome over 10 ft tall may not clear the branches. Grass, so soft after rain. Cove Road is an unpaved forest road from West Tannery Road at Wells Tannery; the sites are about 1.3 and 1.6 miles in. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: SH032 and SH033 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 40 and 60 ft, back-in. SH032 Waterflat is a campsite in DCNR's Waterflat Trail ATV parking lot with a non-flush toilet on site: OHV staging, kept, fact in the note, owner question flagged; vault_toilets written true for the entry. SH033 lists 10 ft overhead clearance, 800-ft grass driveway, Moderate grade: imagery shows the landing open to the sky, track under trees; kept in the count with the caveat, owner question flagged. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; booking/hookups/season confirmed; pull_through false. Pin = SH033's point (0 m), in the landing; SH032 444 m away. 3DEP: SH033 12.4 m below Cove Road. NHD: nothing within 200 m.
flags: OHV STAGING - keep-or-drop question for the owner (SH032): site text 'Located on Cove Road, Wells Tannery at Waterflat Trail intersection and ATV parking lot. Gravel parking lot that will hold 1 camper trailer or 2 vehicles with tents. Easy access but visible from the roadway. Ideal for ATV riding during the summer riding season. Restroom on site.' DCNR's Sideling Hill ATV Trail brochure lists 'Waterflat Trail Parking Area GPS: 40 4 19.9 N, 78 10 41.9 W ... The ATV lot is 0.9 miles on the left' = 40.07219,-78.17831, about 7 m from the site point. So it is a campsite inside an ATV trailhead lot. Nothing restricts it to ATV riders and the calendar sells it to anyone. Imagery: gravel lot ~35 x 30 m with the point in it and a small building (the toilet) on its south-west edge. Kept, with the fact in the note, as p3-361 did for the Refuge Trail and Wells Tannery lots. If the owner drops ATV-lot sites, this entry becomes SH033 alone (count 1).

OVERHEAD CLEARANCE - owner question (SH033): the page lists 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 10'; EKKO is just under 10.5 ft. Unlike the 10-ft sites taken out in p3-358/p3-360/p3-361, leaf-off Esri imagery here DOES show open sky at the site: a pale grass landing about 30 x 20 m with a tapering tail to the north, the point at its centre. What is under trees is the access: 'Access road is 0.15 miles ... Narrow access road but site is secluded' (brochure and DCNR layer: '0.15 miles back off the road past gate'). The 10-ft figure may describe that track; it cannot be seen under the canopy. Kept in the count (count 2, max 60) with the caveat in the note. If the owner treats any listed 10 ft as out, the entry becomes count 1, max_rig_ft 40 (SH032, the ATV-lot site).

SH033 driveway: 'Driveway Surface: Grass', 'Driveway Grade: Moderate', 'Driveway Length: 800'. 3DEP from the site point to the nearest point of Cove Road (217 m, bearing ~298): 471.7 m at the site, 473.8 at 43 m, 475.9 at 87 m, 482.1 at 130 m, 484.5 at 173 m, 484.1 at the road = 12.4 m, about 5-6% on average with a steeper pitch in the middle (6 m in ~45 m on the straight line, which the track need not follow). A two-wheel-drive motorhome has to climb that on grass to leave: wet-weather risk, in the note. Site text: 'Located on Cove Road, Wells Tannery, 0.6 miles from Horton Road. Access road is 0.15 miles. Grass parking lot that will hold 2 camper trailers or 4 vehicles with tents. Narrow access road but site is secluded. Ideal for ATV riding during the summer riding season.'

Gate: the brochure and DCNR layer say SH033 is 'past gate'. Whether the gate stands open or permit holders get a combination is not stated on any page read; a question for the district office (717-485-3148).

facilities.vault_toilets written TRUE for the entry on SH032 only ('Toilet Type: Non Flush Toilets', 'Restroom on site'; DCNR layer Latrines: Yes); SH033 has none (Latrines: No). The note says which site has it.
